item.carvercraft.jewelers_hammer.tooltip: Draws ingots into wire — stays on the bench
item.carvercraft.silicon_carbide_grit.to: Charges the Rock Tumbler, one per cycle
item.carvercraft.polishing_compound.tool: Jeweler's rouge — the Cabbing Machine's final polish
tooltip.carvercraft.band.electrum: Set in electrum — eager to take enchantment, quick to wear
tooltip.carvercraft.band.rose_gold: Set in rose gold — the hardest gold there is
advancement.carvercraft.root.title: CarverCraft
advancement.carvercraft.root.description: Pick up a rough stone. Every material and process past this point is real.
advancement.carvercraft.silver.title: Silver Lining
advancement.carvercraft.silver.descripti: Smelt raw silver into an ingot. Jewelry starts with metal, not stone.
advancement.carvercraft.hammer.title: On the Bench
advancement.carvercraft.hammer.descripti: Forge a jeweler's hammer. It stays in the grid and wears a little with every draw.
advancement.carvercraft.wire.title: Drawn Out
advancement.carvercraft.wire.description: Draw an ingot into wire. One ingot, two lengths — this is what bands are made of.
advancement.carvercraft.band.title: Band Together
advancement.carvercraft.band.description: Bend four lengths of wire into a band. Silver for trinkets, sterling for cabochons, gold for faceted stones.
advancement.carvercraft.alloyer.title: Crucible
advancement.carvercraft.alloyer.descript: Build an Alloyer. Real jeweller's alloys are melted at real ratios, not mashed together on a bench.
advancement.carvercraft.sterling.title: Ninety-Two Point Five
advancement.carvercraft.sterling.descrip: Melt seven silver with one copper. That ratio is why sterling is stamped 925.
advancement.carvercraft.electrum.title: The Enchanter's Metal
advancement.carvercraft.electrum.descrip: Melt silver with gold. Electrum takes enchantment more eagerly than anything else on the bench — and wears out faster for it.
advancement.carvercraft.rose_gold.title: Hardest Gold There Is
advancement.carvercraft.rose_gold.descri: Melt three gold with one copper. Rose gold outlasts every other setting in the mod, which is true of the real alloy too.
advancement.carvercraft.tumbler.title: Six Weeks in a Barrel
advancement.carvercraft.tumbler.descript: Build a Rock Tumbler. No power, no skill, no hurry — four lanes and a lot of waiting.
advancement.carvercraft.grit.title: Grit
advancement.carvercraft.grit.description: Cook sand and coal into silicon carbide. The barrel doesn't turn for free.
advancement.carvercraft.tumbled.title: Baroque
advancement.carvercraft.tumbled.descript: Pull a tumbled stone out of the barrel — smooth, rounded, and no two the same shape.
advancement.carvercraft.trinket.title: Pocket Piece
advancement.carvercraft.trinket.descript: Set a tumbled stone in a silver band. The cheap tier, and the first thing you can wear.
advancement.carvercraft.trim_saw.title: First Cut
advancement.carvercraft.trim_saw.descrip: Build a Trim Saw. A diamond blade cuts anything, so from here on the gate is power, not hardness.
advancement.carvercraft.slab.title: Slabbed
advancement.carvercraft.slab.description: Slice a nodule into flat stock. Slabbing is a cabbing workflow — faceting rough never sees a saw.
advancement.carvercraft.cabbing.title: The Wheel
advancement.carvercraft.cabbing.descript: Build a Cabbing Machine. Grind a dome, sand up through the grits, polish.
advancement.carvercraft.polish.title: Rouge
advancement.carvercraft.polish.descripti: Grind iron into jeweler's rouge. The last stage of every cabochon is red powder and patience.
advancement.carvercraft.cabochon.title: Domed and Polished
advancement.carvercraft.cabochon.descrip: Finish a cabochon. Flat back, domed top, and a shine you put there yourself.
advancement.carvercraft.cab_ring.title: Set in Sterling
advancement.carvercraft.cab_ring.descrip: Set a cabochon in a sterling band. The working tier — solid, and it lasts.
advancement.carvercraft.faceting.title: Index and Dop
advancement.carvercraft.faceting.descrip: Build a Faceting Machine. The most expensive machine in the mod, and the only one worth pointing at a diamond.
advancement.carvercraft.faceted.title: Return the Light
advancement.carvercraft.faceted.descript: Cut a faceted gem. Facets exist to throw light back at you instead of scattering it — which is why you would never facet jasper.
advancement.carvercraft.diamond_ring.des: Set a faceted diamond in gold. The best ring in the mod, and the only thing worth doing with a diamond.
advancement.carvercraft.brilliance.title: Brilliance
advancement.carvercraft.brilliance.descr: Enchant a ring. A better polish returns more light — fifteen percent more of whatever the stone already does, per level.
advancement.carvercraft.bruneau.title: Picture Jasper
advancement.carvercraft.bruneau.descript: Find Bruneau jasper. It comes out of a canyon an hour south of Boise and looks like a landscape someone painted into the rock.
advancement.carvercraft.jeweler.title: Regular Customer
advancement.carvercraft.jeweler.descript: Trade with a village jeweler. They keep grit, rouge, and bands in stock — and no amount of emeralds will buy a star garnet.
advancement.carvercraft.star_garnet.desc: Wear a star garnet. The state gem, found in commercial quantity in two places on Earth, and the only ring here that carries two gifts at once.
